<h1>IR-EMPOWER 2026 Workshop Dates Confirmed</h1>

<p>We are pleased to confirm that the <strong>IR-EMPOWER 2026</strong> workshop will take place in <strong>September 2026</strong>. Exact dates and venue will be announced shortly.</p>

<p>IR-EMPOWER is our network's dedicated training workshop bringing together early-career researchers and experienced practitioners to share knowledge on infrared emissivity measurement techniques.</p>

<p>The 2024 edition, held in Bilbao, was a great success with participants from across Europe. The 2026 edition will build on this with expanded topics including:</p>

<ul>
<li>Directional and hemispherical emissivity measurement</li>
<li>High-temperature techniques</li>
<li>Emissivity uncertainty analysis</li>
<li>Hands-on laboratory sessions</li>
<li>Introduction to the EKHI database</li>
</ul>

<p>Stay tuned for registration details.</p>

<p><a href="https://dulcet-sundae-44ceba.netlify.app/" class="btn btn-outline-primary">View the 2024 Edition</a></p>
